title: Yellowish Venezuelan Blackeye Pea Empanadas
description: A lacto-vegetarian friendly Venezuelan dish featuring blackeye pea, with a mustardy and juicy flavor, perfect for crowds. This empanada is a twist on traditional Venezuelan cuisine.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, butter, and eggs to make the empanada dough.
Add the mashed blackeye peas, mustard, salt, and pepper to the dough and mix well.
Gradually add the milk and vegetable oil to the dough, mixing until a ball forms.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Roll out each ball into a thin circle, about 1/8 inch thick.
Place a tablespoon of the blackeye pea mixture in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough in half to form a half-moon shape and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with a little bit of milk and bake for 20 minutes, or until golden brown.
